title: 左足の十二時
subject: a station shoe-shine stand owner who notices that every customer's tapping foot on his footrest settles at the same tempo, and starts a Friday dance on his one chair
caption: Madchester baggy dance-rock sung in Japanese, loose shuffling breakbeat groove with a hypnotic pulse. Drums playing a live baggy beat with sixteenth hi-hats and a ghost-note snare, wah rhythm guitar scratching in short chops, rolling melodic bass guitar carrying the hook, Hammond-style organ sustaining warm chords, tambourine and maracas on every beat. Hazy 1990 indie-dance studio sound with round low end and light room echo. Young male lead, relaxed nasal mid register, clearly sung with a loose group shout on the hook. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 118 BPM, E minor. Mood: cheeky, loose and danceable. No punk, no rap, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no EDM drops, no heavy distortion.
lyrics:
[Intro - drum loop, wah guitar and bass groove]

[Verse 1]
駅の隅っこ 靴みがき
椅子はひとつ 台はふたつ
客の足が 台に乗ると
こつこつ こつこつ 鳴りはじめる

[Pre-Chorus]
スーツも 作業靴も
なぜか同じ 速さになる

[Chorus]
左足の十二時
ブラシも一緒に 揺れてるよ
こつこつ ゆらゆら
金曜日は 踊る日

[Verse 2]
課長の革靴 ぴかぴかにして
合図をひとつ 手をたたく
「おい 足が勝手に」
課長が笑う 駅が揺れる

[Chorus]
右足も遅れずに
クリームの缶まで 鳴ってるよ
こつこつ ゆらゆら
金曜日は 踊る日

[Bridge - organ and bass only, then drums return]
椅子はひとつ それでいい
踊る場所は ここにある

[Chorus]
みんなの足が そろったら
改札までが ステージだ
こつこつ ゆらゆら
金曜日は 踊る日

[Outro - groove loops and fades, wah guitar]
こつこつ ゆらゆら
